gen-fs-quilon-mulish: Quilon carries a faint nib-pressure swell in its round letters, which gives the headline a commanding, editorial pull. Mulish stays level by comparison, its curves and stems moving in lockstep with wide horseshoe openings.
gen-fs-quilon-poppins: Tall, confident, quietly inked: that is Quilon, with a middling thick-thin shift across its large open letters. Poppins follows with signage-like plainness in every line weight, so the headline gets all the personality while the text just carries on.
gen-fs-rajdhani-fs-sentient: Rajdhani builds every stroke like a pipe, curves as sturdy as stems, so its lines feel modern and tightly engineered. Sentient moves differently, with robust downstrokes and slender turns, and a heading shrunk too small would lose that muscle against it.
gen-fs-recia-fs-bespoke-sans: Wide mouths on the round forms and a moderate thick-thin swing give Recia its literary sophistication. Bespoke Sans stays sharper and flatter, leaving generous space between curve ends and stems, and it does the quiet reading work.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-crimson-pro: Crimson Pro is a text serif with close-packed letters and a subtle thick and thin cadence, refined and a little classic. Red Hat Display sits against it with marker-like strokes of constant width, which makes the serif look even more finely drawn.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-bespoke-slab: Red Hat Display draws everything like bent marker, with crossbars matching the stems and visible daylight inside each curve. Bespoke Slab answers with tall, grounded lowercase that settles comfortably into paragraphs.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-trench-slab: A marker-like line of constant width, with daylight in every curve, defines Red Hat Display against its moderate lowercase height. Trench Slab, a dignified text serif, tightens the gap between x-height and caps.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-alegreya: Alegreya brings a bookish, literary voice, with a light swell in each bowl like pressed glass and wide apertures that resist filling in. Red Hat Display adds a pipe-cleaner firmness on top, so the soft serif text feels even gentler.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-alegreya-sc: Alegreya SC has an authoritative, traditional manner, its wide-open s never tightening and a subtle gradient of weight along each curve. Red Hat Display, drawn like thin plastic tubing, makes that modest contrast stand out.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-aleo: Marker-straight strokes with no stress in the curves mark Red Hat Display. Aleo is the dignified serif partner, and its counters let the eye slip in and out, which is the quality that makes this pair work.
